selection: All France fixtures in the existing 2019 tournament metadata; no opponent or result exclusions
shot_eligibility: All non-penalty Shot events by France; no location/geometry filter needed for counts. Shootouts excluded.
phase_rule: Same-possession, at most 15 seconds; stop at new restart, period/possession change, shot goal or own-goal event. Unique assignment.
aggregation: Pool corners-with-shots over all deliveries; also show each match. Do not average match percentages as the pooled rate.
scope: Descriptive extension on five already inspected fixtures, including extra time. Not fresh validation or causal team ranking.
